newsitem.title: USA: Ten hurt in turbulence on American Airlines flight.
newsitem.headline: Ten hurt in turbulence on American Airlines flight.

text.p: Ten passengers were injured when an American Airlines flight ran into turbulence over the Pacific Ocean, officials said on Friday.

Airline spokesman Tim Smith said the Thursday night flight from Honolulu to Dallas-Forth Worth, carrying 268 passengers and 12 crew, suffered air turbulence at 34,000 feet and was forced to land in San Francisco.
Ten passengers were injured and six were taken to the hospital. Smith said none of the injuries was life-threatening.
The remaining passengers were later flown on to Dallas-Fort Worth International Airport.
